key_insight: FOCUS is a CNS-focused pathology foundation model pretrained on 27,930 frozen sections that improves intraoperative diagnosis and biomarker prediction.
clinical_relevance: It may help surgeons and pathologists make faster, more accurate CNS resection decisions during frozen-section assessment, including better lymphoma detection.
method: Pretrained a subspecialty foundation model on 27,930 frozen-section pathology slides enriched for CNS tissue.
Evaluated on 11 internal diagnostic tasks and 12 biomarker-prediction tasks, including a WHO-aligned diagnostic hierarchy.
Compared model-assisted performance with six neuropathologists across hierarchical diagnosis and lymphoma detection.
evidence_signal: FOCUS achieved mean AUCs of 0.969 for diagnostic tasks and 0.877 for biomarker-prediction tasks, with strong performance in temporal and external cohorts.
watch_item: Performance in real-world intraoperative workflow still needs prospective validation, since frozen-section artefacts and site-specific practice patterns can affect deployment.
paper_title: FOCUS: A Subspecialty Foundation Model for Intraoperative Central Nervous System Pathology
